svg.title: Migrating lower abdominal pain with fever: right-sided appendicitis (ultrasound, usually surgery) or left-sided diverticulitis (CT, uncomplicated managed as an outpatient, abscess or perforation escalating to drainage or surgery), plus painless diverticular bleeding and stricture, each with presentation, numbered investigations and treatment in order

svg.text: Migrating abdominal pain + fever: RIGHT (appendix) or LEFT (diverticula)?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: both are an OBSTRUCTED, inflamed pouch, and both are very common

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: antibiotics for both: ceftriaxone + metronidazole, OR a carbapenem or piperacillin-tazobactam alone
